generate_reference_props_files: run the script to generate reference props files for all Visual Studio project directories
generate_reference_props_for_directory: run the script with --root-path to generate reference props files for a specific Visual Studio directory
generate_and_update_build_props: run the script with --update-build-props to generate reference props and update build props files
get_dependencies: parse a props file to extract dependencies from use props imports
get_project_guid: extract the project GUID from a Visual Studio vcxproj file
